name: Portable twenty-question editable form reference
statement: Provide a useful generic form, editable through accessible controls and context editing, with stable question identities, major answer types, dynamic sections, local publishing, JSON configuration, local response capture/export and optionally configured API submission. Preserve transferable meaning across future native GUI implementations.

provenance.sourceReference: User request for generic 20-question editor, monochrome themes, adaptive aesthetics and Python transference; docs/EXAMPLES/OPENFORM_CONTINUITY.md; implementation mapping pending owner review

verification.expected: Inspect actual browser example with twenty questions; edit a label, add a field and section, publish, enter answers, submit, export and reimport. Verify that theme and viewport changes preserve meaning. Execution currently unverified.
